title: app-shell: two source comments still say design mode is entered from 「Edit app」
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAm8Y73VGNq3PkTe3dc

Filing gate: ③ stale comment with named locations · Source: fleet (PR #37045 "Noted, not filed", found while revising ADRs for #36086)

Since #36789 split the app menu into 「设计布局」 (design mode) and 「编辑应用」 (Studio), design mode is no longer entered from 「Edit app」. Two comments still say it is:

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/ShellPageActions.tsx:10` (module header): "design mode is entered from the app-name menu's 「Edit app」"
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/designMode.tsx:7` (gate paragraph)

Expected: both comments name the 「Design layout」 entry. Comments only, no behaviour.

Business reason: a reader following the comment looks for the wrong entry point.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open "Edit app" design mode comment` → 0.
Clause-②: no · Metadata-protocol: none
Grade: area:build · Task · comment-only → p3.
